gpu_usd_per_hour.source: AWS SageMaker pricing page, ml.g6e.xlarge on-demand, us-east-1

idle_wait_minutes.source: Our endpoint configuration: stops after 7 idle minutes

cold_start_minutes.source: Measured on the endpoint: ~6.5 min machine start + ~40 s model ready

videos_per_cold_session.source: Assumption: three videos batched into one warm session

fixed_usd_per_month.source: Estimate: Aurora wake-ups, S3 and Lambda at low traffic; to be refined from billing

gpu_name.source: Fill in: the exact name in the gpu_name column of the on-prem CSV (the card the benchmark ran on); tco_compare.py refuses to run while it is empty or names a different card

gpu_price_usd.source: Fill in: that card's purchase price, with its source (new or used)

host_price_usd.source: Estimate: workstation to hold the GPU

gpu_tdp_watts.source: Fill in: that card's TDP from the maker's spec sheet

host_idle_watts.source: Estimate: workstation idle draw excluding the GPU

electricity_usd_per_kwh.source: Estimate: Singapore tariff converted to USD
